result.topic_en: Calculations on period relations for Abelian integrals: differences of integrals across cut edges (periods a, b), integrals of products $\int 2u_\iota du_{\iota'}$ around the boundary of the cut surface T, and resulting bilinear relations among the constants $a_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$, $b_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$, $c_{\iota,\iota',\iota''}$.

Same across the a-cut with antisymmetric constants c
Normalized second-order integral W subtracting linear combination of u's
Definition of constants a_{ι,ι',ι''} via c and b
Symmetry properties of a_{ι,ι',ι''} (cyclic and antisymmetric)
Function v with a pole, its integrals against du_ι and boundary contributions
Integration of W du around the whole boundary of T to derive bilinear relations
